Beorn Wunterbrood is a Flaming Fist who appears in the Watch Citadel of High Hall during Act 3 to rally the forces of Baldur's Gate against the Netherbrain. He can be found alongside all the allies whom the player has gathered during the Gather Your Allies quest.
“
May your weapons sing through your enemy's throats.
„
— Beorn Wunterbrood speaking at the High Hall

Involvement

In the Watch Citadel within High Hall, Beorn Wunterbrood is giving a speech to all characters gathered during Gather Your Allies. He urges all of them to put aside their differences and unite against the greatest threat that Baldur's Gate has ever faced, before being interrupted by the entrance of the player. He is initially suspicious of the Mind Flayer within the party (no matter whether they are the player character,  The Emperor,  Karlach, or  Orpheus), but is convinced to trust them by  Withers. After allowing the gathered allies to speak, and the player character to give a short speech, he announces that all these forces will be ready to join the party in battle.

Alternatively, if the party has gathered no allies for the ensuing battles, Beorn Wunterbrood is found dead steps away from the Watch Citadel's entrance (X: 219 Y: 39). In this situation, Withers is waiting inside to berate the party on their lack of tact and diplomatic skills, but nonetheless wishes the party good fortune in the fight to come.

Loot

  • Javelin x2
  • Longsword
  • Plate Armour

Notes

  • Despite being present in the High Hall alongside summonable allies, Beorn does not take part in the final battle and cannot be summoned via  Gather Your Allies.
